nominalReturn.explanation: Our original model returns exactly 96% in expectation at any listed collect step for permitted stakes. Integer payout division floors, but all permitted stakes and listed multipliers divide exactly in this version. This is not a SmartSoft RTP claim.

provenance.observed: One public demo round: stake 0.10 DMO, first collected payout 0.11 DMO at 1.10x; island ladder, Play/Jump/Collect and help viewed.
provenance.designed: Original authored survival probabilities, medium/hard ladders, limits, and state transitions. No SmartSoft backend, source code, RNG, assets or certified RTP is reproduced.

nominalReturn.proof: For collection multiplier M in basis points, survival = floor(9500×1000000/(M+1))/1000000. Expected return = survival × floor(bet×M/10000)/bet, bounded above by 0.95.
